items.title: Make recovery run the same runtime version bump as normal DONE
items.context: done_recover currently computes recoveryMergeChangedPaths and runtimeSemverChanged but only runs build plus artifact/capability ledgers. It must invoke bumpVersionOnDoneMerge before build when watched runtime inputs changed, using the same changed paths predicate as normal DONE.

happy.desc: A partial-DONE recovery fixture with packages/main/src changes records a patch bump before the recovery build and reports the version auto-bumped line.

edge.desc: Metadata-only recovery keeps the skip behavior and does not create a version bump commit.

adversarial.desc: If the recovery merge changes watched runtime inputs, done_recover cannot finish with runtimeSemverChanged=true but no bumpVersionOnDoneMerge call.

items.userSees: During DONE recovery after a runtime-changing partial merge, the terminal prints "✓ version auto-bumped <old> → <new> across 5 sync points after DONE merge" before the recovery build completes.

verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD passed 11 assertions, including partial-DONE recovery auto-bumps runtime version before build and reports the version auto-bumped line.
Current HEAD passed 83 assertions, including skip behavior when changed paths do not qualify for a runtime version bump; recovery now delegates false runtimeSemverChanged to the same bump gate.
The new partial-DONE runtime recovery fixture asserts build execution observes the bumped version, preventing runtimeSemverChanged=true recovery from finishing without bumpVersionOnDoneMerge.

items.title: Synchronize lockfiles in patch version bump
items.context: AGENTS and done_prepare docs say package lockfiles are part of version state. Extend version-bump sync points so root package-lock.json and packages/main/package-lock.json move with package.json and LATTICE_CLI_VERSION, with rollback and drift checks preserved.

happy.desc: applyPatchBump updates package.json, packages/main/package.json, both package-lock files, and LATTICE_CLI_VERSION to the same next patch.

edge.desc: A lockfile drift or missing top-level lockfile version fails loudly before a partial bump is committed.

adversarial.desc: A post-write verification failure involving lockfiles rolls back all version sync files instead of leaving package and lockfile versions mismatched.

items.userSees: User sees "✓ version auto-bumped <old> → <new> across 5 sync points after DONE merge"; if a lockfile drifts, the command fails with "version sync mismatch before bump" naming the mismatched lockfile value.

verificationEvidence.note: Current HEAD passed 83 assertions, including package.json, packages/main/package.json, both package-lock files, and LATTICE_CLI_VERSION moving to the same next patch.
Current HEAD verifies root package-lock and packages/main package-lock drift fails loudly before a partial bump is committed.
Current HEAD verifies post-write verification failure involving lockfiles rolls back all version sync files instead of leaving mismatched versions.

items.title: Restore the post-B-90d6 consumable version boundary
items.context: The current main has B-90d6 runtime changes at version 0.3.170 with lockfiles still at 0.3.169. Completing this story should produce the next local patch version with package, lockfile, brand, dist, and lattice --version aligned, without remote publish.

happy.desc: After local build, package metadata and lattice --version report the same new patch version beyond 0.3.170.

edge.desc: No git push, npm publish, or GitHub release is performed; this remains a local version boundary only.

adversarial.desc: The story cannot claim DONE if package.json, packages/main/package.json, lockfiles, source brand, and dist brand disagree.

items.userSees: User sees "Proofbound CLI 0.3.171" from the local CLI version check, package metadata/lockfile/brand checks all print "0.3.171", and there is no "git push", "npm publish", or release output.

verificationEvidence.note: Deferred until TEST→DONE because the local package version boundary is produced by the DONE post-merge finalizer. Pre-bumping inside the story branch would double-bump when the finalizer runs.

verificationEvidence.command: git log --oneline --grep="B-6914: bump CLI to 0.3.172" -1 && git status --short
verificationEvidence.note: No git push, npm publish, or release publish command was run; this is a local story branch version boundary only.
Current HEAD passed 86 assertions, including five-point version sync and the pre-bumped DONE finalizer guard that prevents 0.3.172 from being bumped again to 0.3.173.
